revolutionize the way drugs are administered and overcome one the most common obstacles effective medical treatment all too often getting the right dose pharmaceutical the precise target proves difficult achieve pills are problematic because the digestive system breaks down many therapeutic compounds before they can reach the bloodstream injections bypass the stomach but are expensive and inconvenient well difficult self administer worst all both needles and pills can cause dangerous fluctuations drug concentrations for example too much insulin kills diabetic too little can put him tumor microchip could deliver high doses toxins the malignant cells without damaging the surrounding organs that the beauty this device you can set any way you want langer says and the long run sept american life changed but most are still not sure what changed into our definition normal continues evolve one thing clear americans are more anxious than ever before the terrorist attacks the world trade center and the pentagon anxiety related disorders cost the united states billion year medical and work related losses now mental health professionals can only make educated estimates how many more people will affected the near future although they have begun studying the problem what the experts know that those most risk specifically for developing post traumatic stress disorder ptsd are people with direct personal involvement the tragedies this high risk group includes not only individuals exposed life threatening danger themselves but also those who watched the events unfold from nearby vantage point lost loved one ptsd typically manifests itself flashbacks nightmares that replay the traumatic event avoidance reminders the ordeal hyperalert state for diagnosis symptoms must persist for more than one month but they may surface immediately those who are going the acute and chronic forms ptsd are very likely exhibit symptoms the hours days after the event says charles marmar professor and vice chair the department psychiatry the university california san francisco and associate chief staff the san francisco veterans affairs medical center marmar estimates that between people new york alone had the kind exposure sept that puts them risk for developing ptsd the count high part due the nature the attacks studies show that rates ptsd are greater following events caused deliberate violence than after natural disasters airplane had accidentally flown off course heavy fog new york and taken down one the towers marmar explains would have been very traumatic but probably less traumatic than knowing that somebody some group wanted kill everybody those buildings this relationship violence that may explain the higher rates ptsd observed women compared with men women are more likely suffer trauma after physical sexual assault although ptsd the most severe reaction traumatic event countless people including many far from new york washington sept have experienced heightened anxiety during the past several months unwelcome their fear might most entirely natural the human nervous system has over time developed array stress reactions among them adrenaline rushes and increased respiration ensure our survival dangerous situations now people immediate mortal danger with nothing fight flee are feeling these reactions firsthand response series extraordinary events individuals with previously diagnosed panic anxiety disorders are likely suffer from more frequent attacks and magnified symptoms according lorna wienstock psychotherapist who specializes the treatment anxiety related disorders but she says many people are walking around state generalized anxiety people feel sense dread and apprehension they feel more vulnerable for most such feelings are normal but clinicians cannot define what exactly constitutes normal reaction because two people are alike experts suggest that trying return some semblance ordinary daily life vital that not easy given the ongoing nature the terrorist threat and the following catastrophes you afraid something that you know what you can avoid diminish some way explains jeff rosen associate professor psychology the university delaware this there nothing diminish people find they are unable leave their homes result anthrax anxiety credible threat consternation their symptoms have become disabling and professional help may required the doctors suggest some researchers far assert that the long term psychological ramifications chemical biological terrorism may more damaging than any february issue conservation biology the cat now faces considerable threats across much its historic dominion owing poaching habitat loss and competition with humans for prey the jaguar once ranged from northern argentina the southwestern united states but since has lost more than half its range the countries the feline still occupies not have coordinated plan for saving biological conservation plans often respect political boundaries more than ecological ones eric sanderson and his colleagues the wildlife conservation society write moreover they note most countries not have endangered species legislation any kind and they laws are unlikely consistent across the nations where the jaguar currently found today the cats are faring best and around the amazon basin long term survival this wide ranging species however will require that the jaguars receive protection variety habitats the authors identified and prioritized jaguar conservation areas countries taking into account their size and connectivity well the extent which jaguar and their prey are hunted are retain broadly distributed species into the next century the team asserts need plan explicitly for their survival young mormons shrug off rejection find meaning door door ministry attention editors this article from the newhouse news service report friday february available separate buy for information about purchasing the article contact debra weydert the new york times syndicate fax mail weyded nytimes com art advisory with photos kurt anderson and duane boyd nns1 and deesta gailey nns2 for information about purchasing art call also transmitting category optional trim words james sweeney newhouse news service undated missionaries kurt anderson and duane boyd worry about rottweilers icy steps and signs warning that the premises are protected smith amp wesson but doors shut their faces that doesn bother them all already belong church slam lutheran and know about jesus christ slam was born and raised catholic slam actually the job one the most fun things anderson said you see such variety people see how they handle themselves and how they present themselves and boyd are missionaries for the church jesus christ latter day saints soldiers army who spread the mormon faith worldwide chances are two them have been your doorstep fresh scrubbed dark ties and white shirts politely inquiring whether you would like know more about their faith chances are you said that they back the relentless work the missionaries reason the church one the fastest growing denominations the country with little more than million members once persecuted and hounded into the utah desert the church now wealthy powerful and basking the spotlight the winter olympics salt lake city the glamour and excitement the winter games are far away for anderson and boyd two young men from salt lake city who are going door door bedford heights ohio bitter january day looking for incentive knock one more door anderson recalls saying popular among male missionaries the harder you work the hotter your future wife will you know knock more doors she great cook knock some more doors she aerobics instructor thoughts marriage and even dating are all the young men have because missionary work leaves little time for relationships anything else time when most young people are preoccupied with school careers the opposite sex just having good time missionaries surrender two years their lives they leave family friends school and jobs enter life that almost military its regimentation and discipline all eligible mormon men are urged serve beginning age about half the church does not have the same expectation women fewer whom become missionaries women must and they serve only months after several weeks training center they can sent any countries though third remain the united states they can ask for specific assignments but where they the church the mormons spend their entire terms the same mission but can move within its boundaries every six weeks often changing companions missionaries are not paid fact they pay the church about for the privilege volunteering for two years return the church rents cheap apartments which they share and supplies subcompact cars though limits the number miles they drive wants them walk ride bicycles which are provided they get month for food and whatever else they need they eat lot macaroni and cheese and instant noodles they work days week they get shower study together from eat breakfast from and study privately from before beginning the day work dinner usually the home local church member but they back work again after eating they return their apartments and are bed hour later wednesdays from are the closest thing day off they have time after doing laundry shopping for groceries and running errands they might bowling play basketball sundays are spent the local mormon church the men wear suits white shirts and ties the women wear long skirts and dark colors the men even the year olds are addressed elder the women are known sister there dating television movies internet newspapers they listen only christian music they gather faculty the new england conservatory for years seems able inspire his players give performances which the amateurs work fully professional level both boston and new york which regularly visits with his orchestra zander has built strong following and the release series recordings recent years both with this boston orchestra and the philharmonia london bound help that following grow for one thing his readings are original and often provocative for another inveterate and persuasive explainer several his recordings include bonus discs which explains his interpretations and the reasoning behind them both philosophical and technical with sideline comments the niceties conducting technique well mahler has long been zander principal specialty and saturday evening brought his boston orchestra carnegie hall explore his thoughts the ninth symphony one might expect this supremely emotional work composed when mahler knew his remaining days were few drew performance from zander which both sweeping gesture and delicate nuance were given careful attention the outer movements mahler most direct and anguished cries from the heart were taken expansive but flexible tempos the opening movement the stretches introspective pathos and lyrical flights nostalgia all put forth with well judged balances and ample dynamic shaping were powerful their way the frantic explosions despair that make the movement heart and the sense life ebbing away the lush string writing the finale could hardly have been made more palpable among the finer touches here were the distinctions zander made between mahler levels pianissimo set between these two immense emotional pillars the second movement with its evocations viennese dance music and the third movement rondo burleske are often undervalued both demand virtuosity and bright coloration and zander readings bristled with energy and showed off the solidity his brass sections and his players ability maintain superbly balanced and polished ensemble brisk speeds but did not let virtuosity eclipse the sense mortal terror that mahler wrote into these deceptively muscular textures there was some tentativeness the orchestra performance the first few pages but the players quickly settled down and gave performance which every department played admirably with particularly beautiful solo contributions from several the information about purchasing art call optional trim words richard read newhouse news service kabul afghanistan man tattered overcoat leans taj mohammad broad wooden desk earnestly stating his case mohammad kabul wali position somewhere between mayor and judge regards him with amused skepticism the man wants the wali whose own education ended 11th grade when fled the soviets help him get friend into medical training mohammad black bearded former northern alliance guerrilla commander jots note his stationery signs with flourish and tears off his pad the next man wants job rural development the next wants the wali back his side intertribal dispute over locating neighborhood office the next aide wants authorization buy parade banner yes says mohammad grand style extending back medieval times buy the cloth and take the painter when many americans last tuned led forces liberated kabul remote control the taliban fled the face surgical airstrikes that left hands fighting northern alliance troops women flung off their burqas celebration music filled the streets for the first time five years sure the military mop would continue and starving people needed feeding but you might have concluded developed nations pledged billions for reconstruction that the afghan problem was pretty much solved turns out peace afghanistan may far more daunting than war nursing country back health lot more difficult than launching airstrikes walk the streets kabul and you find devastated city lacking fundamental means recovery large swaths the capital resemble bullet pocked greek ruins left not from bombing but from infighting decade ago most women fearing physical attacks from fundamentalists still wear burqas even street stalls fill with goods and afghans rejoice peace sporadic violence suggests tribal religious and political fault lines largely invisible western eyes the fault lines deepen the farther they extend from kabul regional warlords fight for territory rival tribesmen terrorize and rob ethnic pashtuns whose clan dominated the taliban unleashing new wave refugees bombed out roads and millions land mines slow relief shipments and prevent farming the current period bears disturbing parallels the last time mohammad crowd took turn running kabul decade ago the mujahedin fighters drove out the soviets and formed similar coalition government only dissolve into civil war that turned kabul into beirut back then the united states washed its hands the country that disengagement led directly the sept attacks failure that must not repeated and yet washington
